gb_matrix.parity_note: Labelled 'parity 1' as in the source document (parameters of the odd-sector of the pre-oscillator form). In the computation they are ordinary (commuting) scalars; see I05 Response.

deformed_relations.rule: [b_j^s, a_1^σ] = - gb_{σ,j,s} κ   (i.e. b_j^s a_1^σ = a_1^σ b_j^s - gb_{σ,j,s} κ)
deformed_relations.kappa: odd, central in A: x κ = (-1)^{p(x)} κ x, κ^2 = 0

inhomogeneous_deformation.value_space: g ⊕ CK  (Z = 'K' is the central K = 1 component)
inhomogeneous_deformation.linearity: γ is linear in the gb parameters; coeff maps gb label -> rational
inhomogeneous_deformation.pairs: all ordered pairs (X, Y); γ(Y,X) = -(-1)^{p(X)p(Y)} γ(X,Y)
inhomogeneous_deformation.parity_rule: p(Z) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 (γ is an odd cochain)
